title: Location of RWE Technology International
content: ### Quick Navigation. ### Back to previous page. The image shows a modern brick building with windows and a sign in front of the entrance. ### Essen. # RWE Technology International GmbH. The RWE site in Essen at Altenessener Straße 32 is the headquarters of RWE Technology International (RWETI) with more than 400 employees. The Essen location has a long tradition: in 1898, RWE was founded as a local municipal in Essen with the Rheinisch-Westfälisches Elektrizitätswerk AG. Since 1965, RWE has been active worldwide as an independent engineering and consulting company in the mining sector. In mid-2015, the technical know-how for the construction and operation of power plant and mining projects in Germany, Great Britain and the Netherlands was bundled in the RWETI. Today, RWETI supports its customers in Germany and abroad in the realization of energy projects in the areas of conventional generation, mining, renewable energies and grid connections. ### Talk to us. ### Quick links.

title: [PDF] CASE STUDY 2
content: CASE STUDY 2 4A Tectonics of the Double Skin Arch 484 Dave Collins 96166041 Building: RWE Corporate Headquarters AG, Essen Architect: Ingenhoven Overdiek und Partner Date: 2000 The RWE building is located in Essen, the new business capitol of Western Germany. This building needed to reflect the modern energy consciousness of its German owner, as well create a place that both employees and visitors could work in complete comfort. Of course, creating a floor-to-ceiling crystal clear curtain wall presents some problems with solar heat gain and glare; natural ventilation poses difficulties maintaining the office environment; air quality, temperature and pressure in the tower all needed to be addressed when designing the curtain wall. For solar shading, aluminum louver blinds are installed in the cavity; the second skin protects these louvers from weather and damage, and reflects 90% of the solar radiation preventing it from getting into the office behind. Inherent in its shape, air that is allowed into the building is adjusted so that its is neither too fast or too slow.

content: # RWE Headquarters in Essen, Germany. ## Uploaded by. AI-enhanced title and description. The document summarizes the RWE Headquarters building in Essen, Germany. It was designed in the 1990s to house 500 staff of RWE AG. The building features a 32m diameter, 34-story tower with an associated 7-story building. It was designed by a team led by architect Christoph Ingenhoven to be Germany's first "ecological high-rise" through its use of natural ventilation and a double-skin facade.
